title: Sovereign Zero-Day Multi-Armed Bandit Clearinghouse Schema (v1.0)
description: Deterministic state-transition contract for the Sovereign Zero-Day Multi-Armed Bandit Clearinghouse. Models statutory pay compression (5 U.S.C. 5303), Beltway prime-contractor skim (sigma_skim), SEAD 4 Guideline H psychometric inversion filters, deterministic Proof-of-Exploit (PoE) hardware oracle verification, dynamic UCB1 scarcity pricing with streaming retention royalties, and the Two-Tier self-sorting recruitment/dark-pool funnel.
